description: Index of every built-in Ferrum Edge plugin at v0.9.9: name, registration failure policy, documented priority, phases and protocol surface, and a pointer to the plugin's config schema in Edge's published openapi.yaml. Build-time custom plugins are not listed.

config_schema_document.note: Each config_schema.pointer is a JSON Pointer into this exact file. The schemas are OpenAPI 3.1 (JSON Schema 2020-12 dialect) and may $ref other components in the same document. They apply to `config` only when the plugin config is enabled. They are referenced, not copied, in this release; see docs/adoption.md (follow-ups).

protocol_values.http: HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3, including HTTPS
protocol_values.tcp: Raw TCP stream proxy, including TLS termination and origination
protocol_values.udp: Raw UDP datagram proxy, including DTLS termination and origination

plugins.protocol_rationale: Config-only: registers named log schemas during cache rebuild; no protocol hooks (ordering priority 9999)

plugins.name: jwks_auth
plugins.protocol_rationale: Requires HTTP headers

plugins.name: oauth2_introspection
plugins.protocol_rationale: Requires HTTP bearer token headers or query params

plugins.name: oidc_relying_party

plugins.name: jwt_auth
plugins.protocol_rationale: Requires HTTP headers

plugins.name: key_auth
plugins.protocol_rationale: Requires HTTP headers or query parameters

plugins.name: basic_auth
plugins.protocol_rationale: Requires HTTP headers

plugins.name: ldap_auth
plugins.protocol_rationale: Requires HTTP Basic auth header; authenticates against LDAP directory

plugins.name: hmac_auth
plugins.protocol_rationale: Requires HTTP headers and a buffered request body; a WebSocket handshake is signed over the empty body and tunnel DATA is never drained; HBONE CONNECT fails closed as incompatible

plugins.name: mtls_auth
plugins.protocol_rationale: Requires TLS/DTLS client certificate

plugins.name: spiffe_identity
plugins.protocol_rationale: Extracts SPIFFE IDs from TLS/DTLS client certificates

plugins.name: mesh_authz
plugins.protocol_rationale: Applies Layer 2 mesh policy using SPIFFE or HBONE identities

plugins.name: opa
plugins.protocol_rationale: Delegates HTTP-family request authorization to an OPA Data API policy

plugins.name: mesh_outbound_registry
plugins.protocol_rationale: Host-header outbound registry gating is HTTP-family only; raw streams use mesh connect/datagram enforcement

plugins.name: compression
plugins.protocol_rationale: HTTP response compression and request decompression (gzip, brotli)

plugins.name: cors
plugins.protocol_rationale: Origin/ACAO enforcement includes browser gRPC-Web requests

plugins.name: security_headers
plugins.protocol_rationale: HTTP-family response security headers and fingerprint stripping

plugins.name: access_control
plugins.protocol_rationale: Needs authenticated identity from an auth plugin; supports consumer username and ACL group allow/deny lists

plugins.name: tcp_connection_throttle
active_phases: on_stream_connect (opaque connection permit releases on rejection/teardown)
plugins.protocol_rationale: Tracks process-local active TCP/TCP+TLS connections per Consumer or canonical client IP; each replica enforces independently

plugins.name: adaptive_concurrency
plugins.protocol_rationale: Target-aware backend admission for HTTP-family upstream survival

plugins.name: ip_restriction
plugins.protocol_rationale: IP filtering is protocol-agnostic

plugins.name: bot_detection
plugins.protocol_rationale: Needs User-Agent header

plugins.name: correlation_id
plugins.protocol_rationale: ID assignment is protocol-agnostic

plugins.name: request_transformer
plugins.protocol_rationale: Modifies HTTP headers/query/body

plugins.name: response_transformer
plugins.protocol_rationale: Modifies HTTP response headers/body

plugins.name: mesh_route_dispatch
plugins.protocol_rationale: Rewrites the routing decision per request via `RequestContext.route_override_*`; for WebSocket, selects the upgrade backend only, not per-frame routing

plugins.name: graphql
plugins.protocol_rationale: GraphQL JSON over HTTP; WebSocket upgrade handshakes are refused fail-closed and post-upgrade frames are never inspected

plugins.name: grpc_method_router
plugins.protocol_rationale: gRPC method-level access control and rate limiting

plugins.name: grpc_deadline
plugins.protocol_rationale: gRPC timeout enforcement and propagation

plugins.name: grpc_web
plugins.protocol_rationale: Translates gRPC-Web (browser) ↔ native gRPC (HTTP/2)

plugins.name: rate_limiting
plugins.protocol_rationale: Connection/session rate applies everywhere

plugins.name: request_size_limiting
plugins.protocol_rationale: Enforces per-proxy request body size limits

plugins.name: waf
plugins.protocol_rationale: HTTP-family always, including complete WebSocket text/binary application messages in both directions; TCP/UDP first-bytes and datagram inspection when a `stream` block is configured

plugins.name: response_size_limiting
plugins.protocol_rationale: Enforces per-proxy response body size limits

plugins.name: body_validator
plugins.protocol_rationale: Validates request and response bodies

plugins.name: openapi_validator
plugins.protocol_rationale: Validates bodies against generated OpenAPI operation schemas

plugins.name: request_termination
plugins.protocol_rationale: Returns HTTP error response

plugins.name: response_caching
plugins.protocol_rationale: HTTP-only response cache lookup and store

plugins.name: response_mock
plugins.protocol_rationale: Short-circuits HTTP and WebSocket upgrade handshakes; native gRPC unsupported by design — only the validated serverless_function terminate contract carries provenance-authorized framed unary Reject semantics

plugins.name: serverless_function
plugins.protocol_rationale: Invokes cloud functions (AWS Lambda, Azure Functions, GCP Cloud Functions); terminate supports HTTP and native unary gRPC

plugins.name: prometheus_metrics
plugins.protocol_rationale: Metrics for all protocols

plugins.name: proxy_alerts
plugins.protocol_rationale: Anomaly notifications across all protocols

plugins.name: otel_tracing
plugins.protocol_rationale: Tracing for all protocols

plugins.name: ai_token_metrics
plugins.protocol_rationale: HTTP JSON/SSE accounting only; native gRPC protobuf has no supported provider schema contract

plugins.name: ai_request_guard
plugins.protocol_rationale: Validates JSON request bodies

plugins.name: ai_rate_limiter
plugins.protocol_rationale: HTTP JSON/SSE token accounting only; native gRPC protobuf frames have no supported usage schema, so gRPC attachment would never charge

plugins.name: ai_prompt_shield
plugins.protocol_rationale: HTTP-only PII detection/redaction for bare JSON prompts; native gRPC unsupported (gRPC-Web framed bodies are skipped)

plugins.name: ai_prompt_compressor
plugins.protocol_rationale: HTTP-only JSON prompt compression; native gRPC wire frames are not rewritten

plugins.name: ai_semantic_firewall
plugins.protocol_rationale: HTTP-only semantic inspection for LLM JSON request and response bodies

plugins.name: ai_response_guard
plugins.protocol_rationale: HTTP JSON/SSE/text response inspection; native gRPC only for methods enrolled in the descriptor-based `grpc` block

plugins.name: ai_tool_governor
plugins.protocol_rationale: HTTP-only deterministic tool/function-call policy on JSON and SSE bodies

plugins.name: ai_semantic_cache
plugins.protocol_rationale: HTTP-only exact/semantic cache for LLM JSON request and response bodies

plugins.name: ai_stream_router
plugins.protocol_rationale: Claims `stream: true` OpenAI Chat Completions, route-overrides to a provider, normalizes provider SSE to OpenAI SSE

plugins.name: ai_federation
plugins.protocol_rationale: HTTP-only; routes final OpenAI JSON bodies to providers, normalizes bounded responses, and relays committed provider SSE incrementally

plugins.name: ai_transcript_audit
plugins.protocol_rationale: HTTP AI transcript capture to a configured sink; native gRPC only for methods enrolled in the descriptor-based `grpc` block

plugins.name: mcp_gateway
plugins.protocol_rationale: HTTP-only MCP JSON-RPC parsing, metadata, and namespaced tool/resource/prompt routing

plugins.name: a2a_gateway
plugins.protocol_rationale: Detects A2A HTTP/REST/gRPC methods, rewrites HTTP and gRPC Agent Cards, applies method policy, and emits `a2a.*` metadata

plugins.name: ws_message_size_limiting
plugins.protocol_rationale: Enforces actual-frame and bounded-reassembly limits on WebSocket connections

plugins.name: ws_frame_logging
plugins.protocol_rationale: Logs WebSocket frame metadata

plugins.name: ws_rate_limiting
plugins.protocol_rationale: Per-connection frame rate limiting for WebSocket

plugins.name: udp_rate_limiting
plugins.protocol_rationale: Per-client-IP datagram and byte rate limiting for UDP proxies

plugins.name: udp_logging
plugins.protocol_rationale: Observability applies everywhere

plugins.name: statsd_logging
plugins.protocol_rationale: Observability applies everywhere

plugins.name: loki_logging
plugins.protocol_rationale: Observability applies everywhere

plugins.name: sse
plugins.protocol_rationale: SSE is HTTP-only (text/event-stream over chunked transfer)

plugins.name: request_mirror
plugins.protocol_rationale: Duplicates traffic to a shadow destination for validation

plugins.name: load_testing
plugins.protocol_rationale: On-demand load testing via header trigger with multi-node fan-out

plugins.name: geo_restriction
plugins.protocol_rationale: GeoIP country allow/deny is protocol-agnostic

plugins.name: request_deduplication
plugins.protocol_rationale: HTTP-only request deduplication and response replay

plugins.name: soap_ws_security
plugins.protocol_rationale: SOAP XML body parsing (text/xml, application/soap+xml, application/xml, application/xop+xml, MTOM multipart/related)

plugins.name: spec_expose
plugins.protocol_rationale: HTTP-only; requires prefix listen_path

plugins.name: api_chargeback
plugins.protocol_rationale: In-memory charge accumulator for HTTP-family, WebSocket bandwidth, and stream sessions

plugins.name: api_chargeback_sink
plugins.protocol_rationale: Durable ClickHouse charge event/snapshot exporter

plugins.name: workload_metrics
plugins.protocol_rationale: Adds Istio/GAMMA mesh identity labels to metadata

plugins.name: __mesh_bpf_metrics
plugins.active_phases_note: no lifecycle hooks; passive Prometheus surface populated by the BPF SOCK_OPS event consumer
plugins.protocol_rationale: Reserved/auto-injected NodeWaypoint BPF SOCK_OPS Prometheus surface (counters + fixed latency histograms); no request hooks

plugins.name: fault_injection
plugins.protocol_rationale: Probabilistic aborts and delays across HTTP-family, TCP stream connect, and UDP/DTLS session + datagram hooks
